decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed part demolition and alterations to the existing garage to create a residential store, and erection of a single-storey rear extension, due to its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of 74 Great South West Road and compatible with the visual amenity of the locality, and would not be detrimental to the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties or result in conditions prejudicial to highway safety. On balance, the development is in accordance with Unitary Development Plan (December 2003) policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4, T.1.4 and the Residential Extension Guidelines (July 2002).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension and store hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the buildings are used.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northeast and southwest walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The extension and residential store hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for the purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 74 Great South West Road.

Condition : 7 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
description: Part demolition of existing garage with remaining part to be used as residential storage, and creation of single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
